## Endpoints

### Data Read (3)
- `GET /adpushupadrorules/{adpushupadroruleId}/platform_adunit_wise/desktop/rules.json` — Get desktop ad rules for a specific ad unit.
- `GET /cvx/client/direct/launcher` — Retrieve client launcher configuration.
- `GET /supply/v5` — Get supply data (likely ad inventory).

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /{id}/{maysqk0Id}` — Update data associated with an ID.
- `POST /adpushupfeedbackwebservice/feedback` — Submit user feedback.
- `POST /adpushupfeedbackwebservice/feedback/testmode` — Submit test user feedback.
- `POST /e/dtb/bid` — Submit a bid for an ad.

### Config (1)
- `GET /cdn/prod/config` — Get production CDN configuration.

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Islamicfinder's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Islamicfinder data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.islamicfinder.org (faster than browser automation)
